#comment: 我们的防线如雪花般消逝

Lines.en: The filthy time travelers hiding in the pole!
Lines.zh: 龟缩在极点的肮脏时间旅行者！

Lines.en: I advise you to give up those evil plans.
Lines.zh: 我奉劝你们放弃那些邪恶的计划。

Lines.en: Otherwise, my troops and I will put an end to your evil plan here and your existence at the same time!
Lines.zh: 否则我和我的部队将在此处终结你们邪恶计划的同时终结你们的存在！

Lines.en: Our plan is evil? Do you know about this, neighbor?
Lines.zh: 我们的的计划竟然是邪恶的，邻居你知道这件事吗？

Lines.en: It's no use discussing whether our plan is evil or not.
Lines.zh: 讨论我们的计划是否邪恶没用任何意义。

Lines.en: The space-time here has become extremely unstable, The doctor's attack could strike at any moment.
Lines.zh: 这里的时空变得非常地不稳定，那位博士的进攻随时可能降临。

Lines.en: Fortunately, our defense line is strong enough and should probably be able to weather this attack.
Lines.zh: 好在我们的防线足够坚固，应该足以挺过这次进攻。

objdata.String: Oh no, our defense line is vanishing like snowflakes!

StringMultiLanguage.en: Oh no, our defense line is vanishing like snowflakes!
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 哦不，我们的防线如雪花般消逝！
